framing_scope.instructions: Which claim is supported by state.framing_evidence and state.limits?

criteria.declared_extent_fixed: The emitted MT7996 INODE frames now cover all original wrapper-entry reads, without establishing selector helper readiness or Wi-Fi root cause.
criteria.wifi_root_cause_fixed: Padding is proved to fix the observed hardware Wi-Fi failure.

compatibility_scope.instructions: Which compatibility statement accurately describes state.source_change?

criteria.valid_other_lengths_unchanged: Valid other profile/command framing lengths are unchanged; invalid-length and NULL-positive-data rejection is intentionally added.
criteria.all_behavior_unchanged: Every other input's behavior, including invalid inputs, is unchanged.
criteria.not_established: Neither statement describes the supplied change.

target_scope.instructions: Which execution scope is established by state.binary_evidence?

criteria.actual_binary_modeled_dependencies: Actual packaged sender instructions execute, with kernel and transport dependencies modeled.
criteria.hardware_transport_validated: Physical mailbox/DMA delivery has been validated.
criteria.source_only: Only recompiled host C was tested; no packaged sender instructions execute.
criteria.not_established: None of these descriptions is supported.

native_readiness.instructions: Does state.framing_evidence establish successful completion of all native INODE selector helpers?

criteria.true: Selector helpers actually complete and establish readiness.
criteria.false: Only wrapper entry and declared read extent are exercised; execution stops before selector helper bodies.

acceptance.instructions: Which project acceptance claim follows from state.build_evidence and state.limits?

criteria.offline_candidate_only: The updated image builds and passes offline checks; complete NPU and hardware/client acceptance remain open.
criteria.full_npu_complete: The NPU implementation and physical/client acceptance are complete.
